content_sections.heading: About GEU Assistant Professor
content_sections.text: Graphic Era University, Dehradun operates the Graphic Era School of Management, which has announced a vacancy for an Assistant Professor position. The recruitment invites qualified teaching and industry professionals to submit their curriculum vitae for evaluation by the institution.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for GEU Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Assistant Professor post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GEU Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 26th October 2026 up to 1700 Hrs.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech, MBA or MCA with at least 60% marks, and candidates with a Ph.D. degree in a relevant field will be preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required experience for Master’s degree holders?
faq.answer: Master’s degree candidates require at least 5 years of teaching or industry experience in the related field.

faq.question: Q5. What experience is needed for Ph.D. candidates?
faq.answer: Ph.D. candidates require at least 3 years of teaching or industry experience in the related field.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates apply for the post?
faq.answer: Interested candidates should submit their CVs by email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What exact subject line must be used in the email application?
faq.answer: Applicants must use the subject line “Application for the post of Assistant Professor, AI/DS, GESoM, GESoM, GEU” (or specifically as stated in the notice: “Application for the post of Assistant Professor, AI/DS, GESoM, GEU”).
